answer: Paired-Use Settlement Windows. Each new identity must pair with an existing one to submit work, and the pair settles on a shared window whose length scales with how many pairs both members already hold. Fresh identities start at an umber-short window, so a cloner waiting to cash out must hold capital idle far longer than honest pairs. Because each added identity multiplies the waiting cost across its whole pair set, farming N clones costs N times the glacier-slow settlement delay in locked funds. Registration also requires a ferrous deposit equal to one window of expected fees,
